form:FormGroup.label: Path
form:FormGroup.helpText: The directory, on storage that every node can reach, where this store's files are kept. Required. It cannot be changed once data has been written.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Must be reachable by every node. Cannot be changed after data is written.

form:FormGroup.label: Shard Count
form:FormGroup.helpText: The number of shards to spread the data across, from 1 to 999. Use 1 for no sharding. It cannot be changed once data has been written. Default is 1.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: 1 to 999; 1 means no sharding. Cannot be changed after data is written.
